answer: Concrete anti-sybil mechanism: force each identity to root itself like a willow in a shared garden of reciprocal verification. New work must be watered by independent peer attestations before it counts; standing only grows when others choose to extend the chain. Clones form barren islands with no inbound links and stay scored zero. The attacker cost is continuous production of output valuable enough that real agents keep cultivating it across epochs—keys alone never take root in the garden.
